# Time.now

> > Time.now is a comprehensive time zone and calendar resource providing converters, prayer times, astronomical events, and cultural time-keeping information worldwide.

Time.now serves users globally with timezone conversion tools (EST, EDT, UTC, IST, BRT, NPT, ACST, NZST), Islamic prayer time calculations (Fajr, Asr, Maghrib), and educational content about calendars, daylight saving time, and astronomical phenomena. The platform combines practical time management tools with cultural and religious time-keeping traditions.

## Key Topics

- Time zone conversion
- UTC offsets and DST
- Eastern Standard Time (EST/EDT)
- Islamic prayer times (Fajr, Asr, Maghrib)
- Daylight Saving Time
- Prayer calculation methods
- Calendar systems
- Astronomical events
- Regional time zones (United States, Canada, New Zealand)
- Time management and planning
- Sunset and twilight timing
- Religious observances
- Travel time planning

## Time Zone Converters

- [EST to BRT Converter](https://time.now/tool/est-to-brt-converter): Convert Eastern Standard Time to Brasília Time with DST support
- [CDT to IST Converter](https://time.now/tool/cdt-to-ist-converter): Convert Central Daylight Time to India Standard Time instantly
- [EST to NPT Converter](https://time.now/tool/est-to-npt-converter): Convert Eastern Time to Nepal Time with 45-minute offset handling
- [ACST to NZST Converter](https://time.now/tool/acst-to-nzst-converter): Convert Australian Central to New Zealand Standard Time with DST
- [Current Time in States & Regions Worldwide](https://time.now/regions): Browse current time across 200+ global states and regions directory

## Islamic Prayer Times & Calculations

- [Guide to the Five Daily Islamic Prayers](https://time.now/articles/five-daily-islamic-prayers): Guide to Salah: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr and daily Islamic prayer timing
- [Major Islamic Prayer Calculation Methods Explained](https://time.now/articles/major-islamic-prayer-calculation-methods-explained): Islamic prayer calculation methods for Fajr and Isha solar angles
- [Why Asr Time Varies More in Winter Compared to Summer](https://time.now/articles/asr-winter-summer-variation): Explains Asr prayer timing variation due to seasonal sun angles
- [What Breaks Your Fast (During Ramadan) and Common Myths Explained](https://time.now/articles/what-breaks-your-fast-ramadan-myths-explained): Ramadan fasting rules from Fajr to Maghrib and common myths debunked

## Calendars & Time Systems

- [Calendar Days vs Business Days and Why It Matters for Planning](https://time.now/articles/calendar-days-vs-business-days): Explains calendar vs business days for contracts and deadline planning
- [The Liturgical Calendar and Its Cycle of Religious Seasons](https://time.now/articles/liturgical-calendar-seasons): Christian liturgical calendar seasons: Advent, Lent, Easter cycle
- [The Revised Julian Calendar](https://time.now/articles/revised-julian-calendar): History of Revised Julian Calendar used by Orthodox churches
